description: This file defines a base activity class in an Android application, extending FragmentActivity, which sets up logging during the activity lifecycle.

classes.name: SampleActivityBase
classes.description: A base activity class providing common setup, particularly logging initialization, for Android samples.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle callback to handle activity creation.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Lifecycle callback to handle activity start, calls initializeLogging().

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up logging by attaching a LogWrapper to the logging chain and logs a 'Ready' message.
